rationale: All 7 blocking findings from the prior request-changes verdict (CR-001..CR-007) are resolved and verified against current HEAD source: numeric coercion added for usage fields, activeDurationMs passthrough test added, cost/active-duration merged into JSON/CSV exports, plain-path cost-enrichment test added, native-loader ownership scan falls back past its byte budget, MetricsWriter.readAll() now skips malformed lines instead of throwing, and DesktopTelemetryRuntime now sums and forwards token totals in the correct sendSessionEnd argument position. No new findings raised — the out-of-band statusline.mjs token-display addition is unrelated to any prior finding and outside this targeted verifier's scope per the dispatch instruction. business_review and standards_review carried forward unchanged from the prior verdict, since review-standards is a final-round-only actor.

standards_review.notes: All 8 commit subjects match <type>(<scope>): <subject>; types/scopes are in commitlint.config.cjs enum; subjects imperative, under 100 chars.
Exported functions have explicit return types, .js imports, interfaces, JSDoc. No new console.log/require(). Pre-existing oversized files only get small additive blocks.

finding_status.notes: Number(usage.*) || 0 coercion added for all four fields; new test asserts non-numeric input coerces to 0.
New aggregator test asserts activeDurationMs passthrough matches the raw session value.
exportJSON/exportCSV now accept and merge costIndex/costSummary; new Active Duration/Cost columns; call sites updated.
New test asserts enrichCosts/formatter cost args are invoked on the plain (non-report) runAnalytics path.
hasOwnershipMarker falls back to a full-file scan when the 256KB bounded scan finds nothing, with a debug log; new test covers it.
Fixed at the recommendation's alternate site: MetricsWriter.readAll() now catches per-line JSON.parse errors and skips the malformed line instead of throwing.
DesktopTelemetryRuntime now sums MetricsWriter deltas and passes tokens as sendSessionEnd's 7th positional arg, matching metrics-api-client.ts's signature; new test confirms summed totals.
